new_scholarship.name: Global Excellence Scholarship
new_scholarship.program_type: University merit scholarship - automatic tuition-fee reduction on admission
new_scholarship.duration: The standard full-time duration of the recipient's accepted course as specified in the letter of offer (typically 3 to 4 years for a UWA bachelor's degree). Where the offer includes an assured pathway into a postgraduate degree the award covers the undergraduate degree only; where the offer is a combined bachelor's and master's degree the award covers the whole combined duration.
new_scholarship.deadline: Applications for the 2027 Semester 1 intake close 11 January 2027 for international applicants from all countries other than those UWA lists, and 28 December 2026 for applicants from the listed countries. Applications for the 2027 Semester 2 intake close 7 June 2027, and 24 May 2027 for applicants from the listed countries. UWA publishes closing dates only and no separate scholarship application or scholarship deadline exists, because the award is made automatically on admission.
new_scholarship.application_period: UWA's International Admissions FAQ states that applications are open at the time of checking, that they can be submitted up to two years before the intended start date, and that closing dates for each intake are listed on the How to apply as an international student page. UWA publishes closing dates only and no separate opening date for this scholarship.
application_method: Automatic on admission. There is no separate scholarship application: apply to the chosen course and UWA Admissions assesses eligibility automatically.
Apply directly to the course through the UWA Application Portal (UWA Apply) or through an authorised UWA agent.

Pay the non-refundable AUD 150 application fee (for international students applying directly and for agents applying on behalf of students); the application is not processed until the fee has been charged successfully.
UWA Admissions assesses eligibility for the course, which may be based on predicted or incomplete results, and issues an offer or conditional offer letter by email.

Provide final academic transcripts. Eligibility for the Global Excellence Scholarship can only be assessed once final transcripts are received, so where final transcripts have not been provided Admissions may issue a conditional offer letter without a scholarship attached.

On receipt of final transcripts Admissions either issues a new offer including the scholarship, or, if the conditional offer has already been accepted and paid, provides a Scholarship contract to sign with the scholarship amount credited to the student account for that semester.
new_scholarship.description: The Global Excellence Scholarship is a tuition-fee discount for high-achieving international students who accept an offer to study at The University of Western Australia. It is worth 10 per cent off tuition fees for undergraduate applicants whose international or overseas qualification is equivalent to an ATAR of at least 85.00, and 20 per cent off for an equivalent ATAR of at least 90.00. Students from all countries are eligible, and the award is made automatically on admission once UWA Admissions has assessed final academic transcripts, so no separate scholarship application is required. The award applies for the standard full-time duration of the recipient's course and UWA publishes it as being in place for the 2027, 2028 and 2029 intakes.
new_scholarship.best_fit: A high-achieving international school leaver whose overseas secondary qualification converts to an ATAR equivalent of at least 85.00 and ideally 90.00 or above, who wants an automatic tuition-fee discount with no separate scholarship application, no essay and no interview, and who can fund the substantial remaining costs of study in Australia.
new_scholarship.eligibility_summary: Open to international students from all countries who have received an offer for an eligible course for 2027 at UWA. Eligible undergraduate courses are all bachelor's pass, bachelor's honours (integrated) and combined bachelor's courses published in the UWA Handbook, together with all combined bachelor's and master's courses and eligible Assured Pathway courses; offers that include, or are amended to include, an assured pathway into Doctor of Medicine (course 91850) or Doctor of Dental Medicine (course 91860) are excluded. Undergraduate applicants must have an equivalent ATAR of at least 85.00 for the 10 per cent tier and at least 90.00 for the 20 per cent tier, where the equivalent ATAR is determined by UWA Admissions having regard to the previous study used to gain entry and may vary occasionally. Recipients must be enrolled full-time as an international student on an Australian student visa (subclass 500) or another visa category with study rights, and must make satisfactory progress while maintaining a Weighted Average Mark of at least 60. The scholarship cannot be held concurrently with any other UWA-issued tuition-fee reduction or academic scholarship, with the sole exception of the UWA English Language Award, and applicants must not have discontinued an equivalent-level course with an immediate break in enrolment after discontinuation.

new_scholarship.english_requirement: UWA's minimum standard English Language Competence requirement for undergraduate coursework is IELTS Academic overall 6.5 with no band below 6.0, TOEFL iBT overall 82 with at least 20 in Speaking and Writing and 17 in Listening and Reading (UWA TOEFL institution code 7496), PTE Academic overall 64 with no band below 60, or Duolingo overall 125 with at least 115 in Speaking, 125 in Writing, 115 in Reading and 110 in Listening. Other accepted routes include LanguageCert Academic overall 67, the Michigan English Test overall 58, the Combined Universities Language Test at 70 per cent, a pass in the English paper of a Group of Eight foundation program, and Australian or Western Australian Year 12 English subjects. Some courses carry a Higher standard or Accreditation ELC requirement listed in their course rules.
new_scholarship.selection_notes: Selection is automatic and academic only. UWA Admissions assesses the applicant's academic records against the published equivalent ATAR thresholds (85.00 for 10 per cent, 90.00 for 20 per cent), and the terms and conditions record the selection criterion as academic achievement with the ATAR as determined by the University. There is no separate scholarship application, no interview, no portfolio, no essay and no published weighting. In exceptional circumstances the University may award the scholarship based on a predicted ATAR equivalent score. Where a student who has not yet provided final transcripts is awarded the UWA International Student Award, Admissions assesses that student for the Global Excellence Scholarship on submission of final transcripts and awards whichever scholarship is of higher value. The awarding body is the Coursework Scholarships Committee and the administering office is the Coursework Scholarships Office.
new_scholarship.notes: This is not full funding. It is a 10 or 20 per cent tuition-fee discount only, and the remaining tuition, all living costs, travel, visa costs and Overseas Student Health Cover remain the student's responsibility. No total dollar value is published or recorded: the current official page and the current full terms and conditions express the award purely as a percentage of tuition fees, UWA reviews tuition fees annually and states they are subject to increase, so any dollar figure would be an estimate rather than an official amount. An earlier published version of the same conditions expressed the identical 85.00 and 90.00 ATAR thresholds as fixed annual dollar amounts, which confirms the tiers are unchanged even though the expression of value has changed. The published deadline is the international course-application closing date, not a scholarship closing date, because there is no separate scholarship application. No closing time of day or timezone is published for that date. The logo used is the UWA crest icon served from the awarding body's own domain; it is the asset already carried in backend/config/official_logo_overrides.json under the uwa.edu.au host key, so this record does not create a second host entry. A dark SVG crest was preferred under PART D but the only crest vector assets found on the UWA static asset domain are the reversed white-on-transparent variants, which are excluded by repo rule 6.

programme_detail_official.tuition_coverage_note: Partial tuition-fee coverage only. The UWA Fees team calculates tuition fees each semester and applies the scholarship automatically before payment is due. Tuition fees are reviewed annually and are subject to increase as outlined in the UWA Acceptance Contract, so the discount moves with the applicable fee. The remaining tuition, the compulsory Student Services and Amenities Fee, and all living costs are not covered.

Applicants without a US Social Security number can use the Duolingo, PTE or IELTS tests instead of the TOEFL iBT.

programme_detail_official.duration: The standard full-time duration of the recipient's accepted course as specified in the letter of offer. Where the offer includes an assured pathway into a postgraduate degree course, the duration is for the undergraduate degree course only. Where the offer is a combined bachelor's and master's degree course, the duration is the combined standard full-time duration of the whole course, including both the undergraduate and postgraduate components. End on Honours is treated as an extension of the bachelor's course and the additional duration is added onto the scholarship.

Hold no other UWA-issued tuition-fee reduction or academic scholarship concurrently, with the exception of the UWA English Language Award.

supplements_or_initiatives: UWA International Student Award: a separate tuition-fee reduction for international students. A student awarded the International Student Award who later provides final transcripts is assessed for the Global Excellence Scholarship and receives the award of higher value.
UWA English Language Award: the one UWA-issued award that may be held concurrently with the Global Excellence Scholarship under the terms and conditions.
UWA Accommodation scholarships and bursaries: listed on the same UWA scholarships index page but separate from this award.

UWA also publishes an Academic English and Study Skills Bridging course at the UWA Centre for English Language Teaching (UWA CELT) for international applicants who do not meet the English requirement for direct entry.

programme_detail_official.description: The Global Excellence Scholarship is offered by The University of Western Australia to high-achieving international students from across the globe commencing undergraduate, postgraduate or combined courses. It is an annual tuition-fee discount for the normal full-time duration of the recipient's course as specified in their letter of offer, with the value determined by the applicant's equivalent Australian Tertiary Admission Rank (ATAR) for undergraduate entry or UWA Weighted Average Mark (WAM) for postgraduate entry. Students from all countries are eligible and must have received an offer for an eligible course for 2027. The scholarship is made automatically on admission once final academic transcripts have been assessed by UWA Admissions; it requires no separate application.
programme_detail_official.program_type: University merit scholarship - automatic tuition-fee reduction on admission
programme_detail_official.coverage: Partial. 10 per cent or 20 per cent of international tuition fees for the standard full-time duration of the recipient's course. No stipend, living allowance, travel allowance, relocation allowance, insurance or family support is published for this award.

application_readiness_checklist: Confirm the chosen course is an eligible undergraduate, combined bachelor's, combined bachelor's and master's, or eligible Assured Pathway course - and not Assured Pathway to Medicine or Assured Pathway to Dental Medicine.
Check the individual course page for admission prerequisites, additional requirements, interviews or auditions, and for any closing date earlier than the general international date.
Map the overseas qualification to an ATAR equivalent using UWA's international and overseas qualifications tables, and confirm it clears 85.00 at minimum and 90.00 for the 20 per cent tier.
Meet or exceed UWA's minimum standard English Language Competence requirement, or plan to satisfy an accepted alternative route.
Prepare clear, full-colour scans of academic results, English test results and passport, plus any course-specific documentation.
Hold the AUD 150 non-refundable application fee ready before submitting; the application is not processed until it is charged.
Plan to submit final academic transcripts as soon as they are available, because eligibility cannot be assessed on predicted results alone.
Confirm the closing date that applies to the applicant's country: 11 January 2027 for Semester 1 2027 generally, but 28 December 2026 for applicants from UWA's published country list.
Model the full unfunded cost before accepting: remaining tuition, compulsory Student Services and Amenities Fee, Overseas Student Health Cover, and living costs in Perth.
common_rejection_risks: Applying to an excluded course. An offer that includes or is later amended to include an assured pathway into Doctor of Medicine (91850) or Doctor of Dental Medicine (91860) makes the applicant ineligible.

Submitting only predicted results and then reassuring yourself the scholarship is secure. UWA states eligibility can only be assessed once final transcripts are received, and a conditional offer issued before that will not carry the scholarship.
Missing the earlier country-specific closing date. Applicants from the published list must apply by 28 December 2026 for the Semester 1 2027 intake rather than 11 January 2027.
Assuming a separate scholarship application exists and waiting for a scholarship round that never opens.
Assuming the award is fully funded. It is a tuition discount only, and the unfunded share of tuition plus all living costs remains.
Holding another UWA tuition-fee reduction or academic scholarship at the same time, which is not permitted other than alongside the UWA English Language Award.
Assuming the discount is a fixed dollar amount. It is a percentage of tuition fees, so its value changes with the course and with annual fee increases.
Not meeting the WAM 60 continuation requirement or failing to complete the twice-annual eligibility confirmation once enrolled.
estimated_uncovered_costs: The remaining 80 to 90 per cent of tuition fees for each semester or year of the course.
The compulsory Student Services and Amenities Fee payable for each year or part year of study.

Overseas Student Health Cover, which the Australian Department of Home Affairs requires for the whole duration of the student visa; UWA's preferred provider is Medibank and cover can be arranged on acceptance and payment of the offer.
Return airfares and travel to and from Australia.
Student visa application costs and biometrics, payable to the Australian Department of Home Affairs rather than to UWA.
Accommodation and cost of living in Perth, which UWA advises applicants to budget for before applying.
Books, equipment and other personal expenses, which are not covered by this award.
document_audit: Academic results: must be the results for the qualification used to gain entry; a clear, full-colour copy is acceptable. A copy of the testamur or completion certificate is expected where the qualification has already been completed.
Final academic transcripts: these are the single document that unlocks the scholarship. A conditional offer without them will not include the Global Excellence Scholarship.
English test results: the test must be one of the accepted tests and must meet the minimum standard for the chosen course; some courses require Higher standard or Accreditation ELC scores.
Passport copy: used for identity and visa documentation.
Course-specific documents: UWA lists any additional documentation required for the chosen course, so check the course page before applying.
When responding to an offer, UWA asks for scans or clear photographs of the requested documents rather than certified originals.
Keep the offer email and any Scholarship contract, because the offer sets an expiry date for acceptance and the Scholarship contract states the scholarship amount.

alerts.message: There is no separate scholarship application for the Global Excellence Scholarship. Applying to the chosen course is the entire scholarship application, so submitting only a scholarship form would achieve nothing.

If you apply on predicted results, UWA may issue a conditional offer with no scholarship attached. Send your final transcripts as soon as they are available; Admissions will then issue a new offer including the scholarship, or send a Scholarship contract to sign if you have already accepted and paid.

Check whether you are applying from a country on UWA's published list. Those applicants have a 28 December 2026 closing date for the Semester 1 2027 intake, more than two weeks earlier than the general 11 January 2027 date.

An offer that includes an assured pathway into Doctor of Medicine (91850) or Doctor of Dental Medicine (91860) is not eligible for this scholarship. Check the offer letter before assuming the discount applies.

UWA publishes the closing date but no closing time or timezone. Do not leave the submission until the final hours; if you must submit on the closing date, confirm the cut-off with the Future Students Centre or your agent.

The scholarship is conditional on satisfactory progress and a WAM of at least 60, plus a twice-annual confirmation that you still meet the eligibility requirements. Diarise those confirmations as soon as you enrol.

If you need to defer, you can defer a 2027 commencement to 2028 and keep the scholarship, because the award is published as being in place for the 2027, 2028 and 2029 intakes. Confirm the deferral with Admissions rather than assuming it.

submission_workflow: Choose the course and record the course name and code, checking prerequisites, additional requirements and any earlier closing date on the course page.
Create a profile in UWA Apply or contact an authorised agent.
Select the course, the entry pathway and upload supporting documents, including clear full-colour copies of academic results, English test results and passport.
Pay the AUD 150 non-refundable application fee; the application is not processed until the fee is charged successfully.
Submit the application and track its progress in the UWA Application Portal.
Await the offer or conditional offer letter by email, noting the acceptance expiry date.
Send final academic transcripts as soon as they are available and ask Admissions to reassess the application.
Receive the new offer including the scholarship, or the Scholarship contract to sign if the conditional offer was already accepted and paid.
Accept the offer through UWA Apply or the accept link in the offer email, agree to the terms and conditions of studying at UWA, and make the first payment.
Arrange Overseas Student Health Cover and the student visa, then enrol full-time as an international student.
Confirm that the Fees team has applied the scholarship to tuition fees before each semester's payment is due, and complete the twice-annual eligibility confirmation.

logo_override.validation_detail: png 18726+B; probed live and returned HTTP 200 with Content-Type image/png; decoded at 180x180 pixels with 19468 opaque and 12932 transparent pixels
logo_override.probe_note: The asset is served by www.uwa.edu.au, the awarding body's own domain, and is declared in the <head> of the official scholarship page as the shortcut icon. Probed live on 2026-10-03: HTTP 200, Content-Type image/png, 18726 bytes. Decoded in a real browser session: 180x180 pixels, valid PNG, 19468 opaque pixels and 12932 transparent pixels. Colour check for repo rule 6: the dominant opaque colours are UWA dark blue (bucket 0,64,128 with 9227 pixels) and gold (bucket 224,160,0 with 4496 pixels), with only 1657 pixels above the near-white threshold out of 19468 opaque pixels. research_notes.degree_level_confirmed: Confirmed as bachelor's-level from three official sources. First, the scholarship page states 'If you're looking to start studying in 2027, you could receive up to 20%* off your tuition fees for the entire duration of your eligible undergraduate or postgraduate course', and its Undergraduate eligibility section requires the candidate to be 'applying for an eligible undergraduate course, combined bachelor's degree, combined bachelor's and master's degree, or Assured Pathway course', with the ATAR 85.00 and 90.00 thresholds. Second, the full terms and conditions Schedule 1 states that 'Eligible undergraduate courses include all undergraduate bachelors pass, bachelor honours (integrated), or combined bachelors degree courses offered by the University and published in the UWA Handbook' and that 'Eligible Combined Bachelors and Masters degree course include all combined Bachelors and Masters courses offered by the University and published in the UWA Handbook'. Third, the entry standards page confirms UWA's general undergraduate entry is an ATAR of 75 or above, which is the scoring basis the scholarship thresholds reference.
